sermon.title: Spiritual hurdles - November 19, 2023
sermon.speaker: Church member (not Pastor Kincer; name not given)
sermon.summary: A church member filling in teaches from the parable of the talents that the servant hid his talent because his perception of his master was wrong. God is not a hard master: He numbers our hairs, delights to give us the kingdom and casts our sins into the sea. The hurdles to overcome are hypocrisy, bad choices and stunted doctrine, and the cure is the simplicity in Christ and His living word and Spirit.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Worship runs to about 25:45. She cites “Romans 12:19” for “let love be without dissimulation” (Romans 12:9) and “1 John 5 1-5.” “A cup of coin” in Matthew 10:29 is as captioned (NKJV “a copper coin”).

scriptures.text_nkjv: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a man traveling to a far country, who called his own servants and delivered his goods to them. And to one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one, to each according to his own ability; and immediately he went on a journey. Then he who had received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents. And likewise he who had received two gained two more also. But he who had received one went and dug in the ground, and hid his lord’s money. After a long time the lord of those servants came and settled accounts with them. “So he who had received five talents came and brought five other talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents; look, I have gained five more talents besides them.’ His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant; you were faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’ He also who had received two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents; look, I have gained two more talents besides them.’ His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant; you have been faithful over a few things, I will make you ruler over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

faqs.question: Is there a handout?
faqs.answer: A little sheet with no blanks, unlike the ones Michael always has.

faqs.question: Did she come up with something profound?
faqs.answer: She says she doesn’t think she has, but God’s word is full of surprises.

faqs.question: What are parables?
faqs.answer: Truths that Jesus gives in story form.

faqs.question: Is there a good fear?
faqs.answer: Yes, godly fear, which is respect.

faqs.question: Does God see our sins after we repent?
faqs.answer: She says our sins are far from Him; He doesn’t see them when we repent.

faqs.question: Did she pause for people to look up verses?
faqs.answer: Yes; take your time, we’re having Bible study.

faqs.question: Why try so hard with young people?
faqs.answer: To get them on the right course so they don’t take that one step to a wrong choice.

faqs.question: What is the soul?
faqs.answer: The inner life of our own experience: mind, heart, will, imagination, thoughts and desires.

faqs.question: Should I worry about the Spirit and tongues?
faqs.answer: She says you don’t need to worry about that, as some people do.
